column1: # Daily issues named in the close of each annals entry, Days 91-100 (annals.html, same fetch as the
# Daily list). One list per day (annals-day-N), rows in the order the close names them. A Daily that the
# close says is listed or counted twice is two rows. Annals entries and other items in a close are not
# rows. date = the date the close sentence gives (year from the entry date), empty when it gives none.
# Day 95 names no Daily in its close and has no rows. Quotes and provenance: evidence.json.
